summary.en: Translate short-circuit Boolean expressions, conditionals and loops using true, false and next lists with explicit backpatching.
summary.bn: শর্তে কোন পথে যাবে, তা jump দিয়ে লিখবে; পরে জানা লেবেল backpatching দিয়ে বসাবে।

notes: Python programs use the standard library and were executed with Python 3.12.14.

practice.title: Build Boolean lists
practice.statementHtml: Translate a<b AND c<d and state its final true and false lists before statement targets are known.
hints: The first true jump enters the second comparison.
practice.answerHtml:
For B1 AND B2, evaluate B2 only when B1 is true. Patch B1.truelist to the first instruction of B2. The combined true list is B2.truelist. False can arise from either operand, so merge both false lists.

For B1 OR B2, evaluate B2 only when B1 is false. Patch B1.falselist to the beginning of B2. Merge both true lists, and keep B2.falselist as the combined false list. A logical NOT swaps the true and false lists without emitting an arithmetic negation.

List equations for short-circuit translation
ExpressionPatch before second operandResult truelistResult falselist
B1 AND B2B1.true → start(B2)B2.truemerge(B1.false,B2.false)
B1 OR B2B1.false → start(B2)merge(B1.true,B2.true)B2.false
NOT B1noneB1.falseB1.true

Consider a < b AND c < d. The first true jump must enter the second comparison, while its false jump must skip it. This matters if the second operand has an effect or is unsafe unless the first condition succeeds, such as an array access protected by a bounds condition.

AND expression before statement destinations are known
IndexEmitted instructionCurrent status
0if a < b goto 2First true list patched to second relation
1goto _Combined false list member
2if c < d goto _Combined true list member
3goto _Combined false list member

Now B.true = [2] and B.false = [1,3]. Instruction 0 is absent from the final lists because it already has its destination. Recording that distinction helps prevent a later patch from sending it directly to the statement body and bypassing c<d.

practice.title: Patch an if-else
practice.statementHtml: Translate if (a<b AND c<d) x=1; else x=0; followed by print x, including every patch.
hints: The then branch must jump around else.
practice.answerHtml:
Translate if (a<b AND c<d) x=1; else x=0;. The true branch starts at 4. Its final jump skips the else branch. The false branch starts at 6, and instruction 7 is the first instruction after the entire conditional.

Completed if-else TAC
IndexInstructionReason
0if a < b goto 2Continue AND evaluation
1goto 6First comparison false
2if c < d goto 4Both comparisons true
3goto 6Second comparison false
4x = 1Then branch
5goto 7Skip else after then
6x = 0Else branch
7print xJoin after the conditional
Backpatch operations for the if-else
MomentListTargetEffect
Begin second relation[0]2Enable short-circuit AND
Begin then branch[2]4Select x=1
Begin else branch[1,3]6Select x=0
Reach join[5]7Then branch skips else

The print operation is included to give the join a concrete instruction index. Some intermediate formats allow a label just past the last instruction. Others require an explicit exit block. State your convention instead of treating an out-of-range jump as an ordinary instruction index.

practice.title: Translate a while loop
practice.statementHtml: Generate indexed TAC for while(i<n) i=i+1; print i and explain its zero-iteration path.
hints: Save the beginning of the test.
practice.answerHtml:
Translate while (i<n) i=i+1; print i;. Save the condition's start before emitting its comparisons. Patch the true list to the body and the false list to the loop exit. After the body, emit a backward jump to the saved condition start.

Complete while translation
IndexInstructionControl purpose
0if i < n goto 2Enter body when condition holds
1goto 5Exit on false
2t1 = i + 1Body calculation
3i = t1Body update
4goto 0Recheck the condition
5print iFirst instruction after loop

The backward jump targets the condition, not the body. Otherwise a true first test would make the loop repeat without checking i<n again. Zero iterations are possible: if the condition is initially false, control reaches instruction 5 without executing the update.

practice.title: Compose exits
practice.statementHtml: Explain next lists for if, if-else, while and a sequence of two statements.
hints: Unfinished continuation jumps differ from natural fallthrough.
practice.answerHtml:
A statement's nextlist contains unfinished jumps that should continue after that statement. For S1 followed by S2, patch S1.nextlist to start(S2). S2.nextlist then becomes the sequence's remaining nextlist. A statement that naturally falls through does not need an artificial jump merely to have a nextlist.

Sequence and loop exit lists
ConstructOutstanding exitsWhen patched
if B then SB.false plus S.nextAt the following statement
if B then S1 else S2Skip-else jump plus branch next listsAt the join
while B do SB.falseAt the first statement after the loop
S1; S2S2.next after patching S1.nextWhen sequence continuation is known

A break statement creates an exit for the nearest enclosing loop, not for every enclosing conditional. A continue statement targets that loop's next test or update according to the source construct. Maintain a loop-context stack if you extend the translator with these statements. Nested loops require separate exit lists.

quiz.prompt: What does a truelist contain during backpatching?
quiz.explanation: The list records locations whose destinations will be filled later.

quiz.prompt: Which list is patched to B2 for B1 AND B2?
quiz.explanation: Only a true B1 result should proceed to evaluate B2.

quiz.prompt: Which list is patched to B2 for B1 OR B2?
quiz.explanation: A true B1 result already satisfies OR and must skip B2.

quiz.prompt: How is NOT represented in the list model?
quiz.explanation: Negation exchanges the destinations selected by the original truth result.

quiz.prompt: Why emit a skip-else jump after the then branch?
options: To avoid executing else after then
quiz.explanation: Ordinary fallthrough would otherwise execute the else code as well.

quiz.prompt: Where must a while back edge lead?
quiz.explanation: The condition must be checked before every new iteration.

quiz.prompt: For the worked AND, which false list remains after patching instruction 0 to 2?
quiz.explanation: Either comparison can be false; instruction 0 is already resolved.

quiz.prompt: What is nextinstr before emitting an instruction?
options: The index of the next instruction
quiz.explanation: A marker can save that index as a later branch destination.

quiz.prompt: When is a while body allowed to execute zero times?
options: Only when the body is empty
When its first condition is false
quiz.explanation: The entry test can branch directly to the exit.

quiz.prompt: What structural condition should hold after a function is fully patched?
options: Every statement needs a new jump
quiz.explanation: All pending destinations must have been supplied before later control-flow processing.

quiz.prompt: How is S1.next handled before translating continuation S2?
quiz.explanation: Sequence continuation gives the missing destinations of S1's exits.

keyPoints.en: Backpatching fills destinations of previously emitted unfinished jumps.
keyPoints.bn: আগে লেখা jump-এর ফাঁকা গন্তব্য পরে backpatching দিয়ে পূরণ করো।

keyPoints.en: AND reaches its second operand only after a true first operand.
keyPoints.bn: AND-এ প্রথম শর্ত সত্য হলেই দ্বিতীয় শর্ত দেখো।

keyPoints.en: OR reaches its second operand only after a false first operand.
keyPoints.bn: OR-এ প্রথম শর্ত মিথ্যা হলেই দ্বিতীয় শর্ত দেখো।

keyPoints.en: An if-else needs a jump that skips the else branch after then.
keyPoints.bn: then অংশ শেষে jump দাও, যেন else অংশে ঢুকে না যায়।

keyPoints.en: A while back edge returns to the condition test.
keyPoints.bn: while-এর শেষে আবার শর্ত চেক করার জায়গায় ফিরে যাও।
